newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com rated a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com rated a strong buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of 3Com Corp with a strong buy rating based on the expectation it will grow faster than the networking industry.

-- In written research, the investment firm said operating margins are increasing to over 20 percent, and it cites new products and a strong systems business that will give 3Com an edge over competitors.
-- Hambrecht & Quist believes the company will earn $2.30 a share on revenue of $3.27 billion in 1997, which should rise to earnings of $3.08 a share on revenues of $4.46 billion in 1998.
